title: Standard ABC optimizer, DB-backed HPO service with multi-seed evaluation and retention, HPO UI and watch screen
purpose: Replace MOABC (single-objective in practice, onlookers identical to employed bees, single seed, JSON-file scoring) by a standard ABC (Karaboga 2005) with an optional Pareto mode (Deb 2001), evaluate candidates on several seeds from the database, keep summary rows and purge evaluation data per K9, and provide a web UI to create, watch, cancel and apply studies.

ui: agent_library.ui (views.py and urls.py edited in wave 5)

work_packages.notes: Pure numpy, no Django, no torch. Evaluation is injected as a callable so the optimizer can be tested on synthetic functions.

modify: abmem/services/algorithms/optimization/optimizer.py (thin wrapper calling the run_hpo command logic, PLAN 2.4)
abmem/views.py (simulation_list excludes HPO evaluation runs: filter(proxy=False, hpo_trial__isnull=True), dashboard counts likewise)

work_packages.notes: Apply-best-parameters target depends on OQ-9. If approved, this package adds the model field(s) and migration 0012 (or the next free number) and registry.build_policy parameter resolution.

public_interfaces.description: Search happens in the unit cube [0,1]^D. 'log' maps through log10 (requires low > 0), 'int' rounds on decode. Validation: low < high, finite, names unique. Each study builds its own ParamSpace from HPOStudy.param_bounds (no module-level dict, B10).

Karaboga (2005), Karaboga and Basturk (2007). SN = colony_size food sources initialised uniformly. Employed phase: for each i, pick k != i and one random dimension j, v_ij = x_ij + phi * (x_ij - x_kj), phi ~ U[-1, 1], clip to [0, 1], greedy selection, trial counter update. Onlooker phase: SN onlookers choose sources with probability p_i = fit_i / sum fit (roulette wheel) and apply the same move and greedy selection. Scout phase: the single source with the largest trial counter is replaced by a uniform random source if its counter exceeds limit. Weighted mode: score = w1 * agent + w2 * market, cost c = -score, fit = 1 / (1 + c) if c >= 0 else 1 + |c|. Pareto mode: greedy replacement only if the candidate Pareto-dominates the current source (Deb 2001), fit_i = 1 / rank_i from fast non-dominated sorting of current sources, external archive of all non-dominated evaluated candidates. Evaluations of one phase are submitted as one batch (synchronous variant, OQ-19). should_stop is checked before every batch (cancel). Fully determined by rng.

public_interfaces.signature:
def dominates(a: Sequence[float], b: Sequence[float]) -> bool
def non_dominated_sort(points: Sequence[Sequence[float]]) -> list[int]
def pareto_front(points: Sequence[Sequence[float]]) -> list[int]
public_interfaces.description: Maximisation. dominates: a >= b in all objectives and > in at least one (Deb 2001). non_dominated_sort returns rank per point (1 = first front).

Computed from the database (1.11), not from JSON. Per agent over the scored periods: profit_total = sum offer_profit (equals final minus true initial budget, B9), capacity = total plant capacity (B9), P_max = Market.upperBidBound (not 200). Default definitions are the legacy agent_score and market_score of docs/legacy_rewards.md with these B9 corrections. The study objective combines them with per-study weights (OQ-11). periods defaults to all periods (or the evaluation window Simulation.evaluation_periods, OQ-5).

public_interfaces.description: validate_study_input: scenario is a proxy Simulation, bounds keys are fields of the algorithm's config class (or failstack_limit / failstack_delta when fail-stack is enabled), low < high within dataclass validation ranges, colony_size >= 2, seeds non-empty, distinct, search and evaluation seeds disjoint. start: closes DB connections, spawns multiprocessing.get_context('spawn').Process(target=bootstrap.run_hpo_process, args=(study.id,)). run_study (in that process): status RUNNING, builds ParamSpace and ArtificialBeeColony with an evaluate callback that expands each candidate into (candidate, seed) tasks for all search seeds, runs them in Pool(processes=min(cpu_count(), n_tasks), initializer=bootstrap.init_hpo_worker, maxtasksperchild=1), writes HPOTrial rows, averages per candidate, applies retention, checks cancel_requested between batches. After the search: FINAL_EVAL phase on evaluation_seeds for the best candidate, best_params and best_score from FINAL_EVAL, status FINISHED. Any exception: status FAILED, error = last 4000 characters of the traceback. Cancel: pool.terminate(), status CANCELED. param_space_payload returns defaults and default bounds from AlgorithmConfig for the create form.

Top-level picklable. Clones the scenario with library_service.clone_scenario_for_run(seed=task.seed, forced_algorithm=study.algorithm_type (K7), algorithm_overrides=decoded algorithm params, fixed_agent_fields=fail-stack settings from fixed_params and searched failstack_limit/failstack_delta), runs simulation_service.run(sim, export_json=False) in-process, scores with score_simulation, updates the HPOTrial row (status, scores, duration, simulation). Failures mark the trial FAILED with error text and return objectives (-inf, -inf) so the candidate is never selected (documented in FORMULATION).

public_interfaces.signature:
def purge_simulation_details(simulation: Simulation) -> None
def apply_retention(study: HPOStudy, best_candidate_key: tuple[int, int, int] | None) -> None
public_interfaces.description: K9: purge deletes Period (cascades Offer and AgentStepLog) of a scored evaluation simulation and keeps the Simulation, Market and Agent rows. apply_retention keeps full data only for the trials of the current best candidate and purges everything else that is FINISHED, including the previous best when it is displaced.

ui_contract.create_form: Scenario select (proxy simulations only), algorithm select, fail-stack on/off (when on: optional inclusion of failstack_limit and failstack_delta in the searched parameters, otherwise fixed values), dynamic parameter bound rows loaded from /dev/hpo/param-space/?algorithm= (min, max, scale, include checkbox, default shown), ABC settings (colony size, iterations, limit), search seeds and evaluation seeds (comma-separated integers), objective settings (mode weighted/pareto and weights).
ui_contract.watch: Polling of study_status every 2 s while RUNNING. Progress bar, best-score-per-iteration line chart and agent-score versus market-score scatter (Chart.js already bundled at static/assets/js/plugins/chartjs.min.js), trial table, cancel button (RUNNING only), apply-best button (FINISHED only, OQ-9).

data_model_changes: none (all schema changes are in data_model 0011 and 0012)
migrations: none (all schema changes are in data_model)
invariants: No module-level mutable dict of bounds or algorithm type (B10).
Every (candidate, seed) evaluation has exactly one HPOTrial row.
Reported best_score comes from evaluation seeds that were not used in the search (1.11).
After a FINISHED study only the best candidate's evaluation simulations keep Period/Offer/AgentStepLog rows (K9).
All scenario agents of an evaluation run use the study algorithm (K7).
ABC with a fixed rng seed and a deterministic evaluate callback is reproducible.
edge_cases: colony_size 2: k != i always the other source.
max_iter 0 rejected (validation), limit larger than possible trial counts: scouts never trigger (logged, not an error).
All fitness values equal: uniform onlooker probabilities.
Negative scores in weighted mode: fit = 1 + |c| branch.
Evaluation failure in a worker: trial FAILED, objectives -inf, study continues. If all evaluations of a batch fail, the study is FAILED.
Cancel during a batch: the running batch is terminated, its unfinished trials marked FAILED with 'canceled', status CANCELED.
Scenario deleted while a study references it: PROTECT error shown in the UI.
Seeds out of the 0..2^32-1 range: validation error.
Log-scale bound with low <= 0: validation error.
test_plan: test_param_space.py: unit-cube round trip, log scale, int rounding, invalid bounds.

test_abc_optimizer.py: on the negated sphere function in 4-D (known optimum at the origin, a standard benchmark in Karaboga and Basturk 2007) with colony 10, 50 iterations, the best value is within 1e-2 of the optimum (PLAN 1.11 validation). Onlooker selection frequencies follow p_i (chi-square check on a fixed population). Scout triggers when trial > limit. Only one dimension changes per move. Pareto mode keeps a correct archive on a two-objective toy problem.
test_pareto.py: dominance cases, ranks on a hand example.
test_objective.py: hand-built simulation with known offers, B9 corrections (initial budget, total capacity, P_max from market).

test_hpo_service.py: small study (2 sources, 1 iteration, 1 search seed, 1 evaluation seed, 10-period scenario with baselines to keep it fast) run synchronously with the Pool replaced by a serial map: trial count, status FINISHED, best from FINAL_EVAL. Cancel flag set before the second batch -> CANCELED. Injected worker exception -> trial FAILED, study continues.
test_retention.py: only best candidate keeps periods, displaced best gets purged.
test_hpo_views.py: create form validation errors, status JSON shape, cancel endpoint, CSRF required.

resolved_open_questions.OQ-5: Simulation.evaluation_periods: the last N periods run with explore=False and no learning (RunPhase.EVALUATE).
resolved_open_questions.OQ-9: Agent.algorithm_params (JSON) plus AlgorithmDefault model, both added by data_model (migration 0012). Effective params = AlgorithmDefault for the type, overridden by Agent.algorithm_params, overridden by HPO overrides.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-11: HPO objective = weighted single objective with per-study weights. Pareto front is shown on the watch screen as information only and never used for selection.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-17: HPOStudy.heartbeat_at (added by data_model in 0011). Stale RUNNING studies become FAILED after settings.ABMEM_HPO_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-19: Batch-synchronous parallel ABC accepted. It must be documented in FORMULATION.md as a variant of Karaboga (2005), not as classic ABC.

resolved_behaviour: Objective: weighted single objective, weights per study. The Pareto front is computed for the watch screen only (OQ-11).
HPOStudy.heartbeat_at comes from data_model 0011, Agent.algorithm_params and AlgorithmDefault from data_model 0012. The hpo ui package adds NO migration (OQ-9, OQ-17).
ABC is the batch-synchronous parallel variant, documented in FORMULATION.md (OQ-19).
